Submit an event

Uses 1 credit once approved. You have 4 available. Editors usually review within 2 working days.

Event details

Times are UK time. Multi-day events are fine, up to 7 days. The listing leaves What’s On automatically after the end date and time. There is no limit on how far ahead you can submit.

What happens next

1 credit is held when you submit. It is only deducted when an editor approves.

An approved listing appears 60 days before the event at the earliest, or straight away if the event is sooner.

If we cannot publish it you get the reason by email and the credit goes back to your balance.

You can withdraw or edit while it is pending.

What’s On listing terms

  1. One credit publishes one event listing once approved.
  2. A credit is held when you submit and only deducted on approval; a declined listing returns its credit.
  3. Credits have no cash value and are not refundable, except where a listing fails because of a platform fault.
  4. Credits expire 12 months after purchase. A 5-pack is not transferable.
  5. Listings must be for a real event in our area; editors may decline any listing.
